behaviour: Searches the text and frame names of every page, labels each match with its page, and switches to a match's page before focusing it.
rules: `SearchMatchItem` gains `pageId: string` and `pageName: string | null` (null when the drawing has a single visible page).

`handleSearch` scans `app.scene.getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()` filtered to non-deleted elements instead of `app.scene.getNonDeletedElements()`; each pushed item sets `pageId: element.pageId ?? app.state.activePageId` and `pageName` from a `Map` of `getVisiblePages(app.state.pages)` ids to names (null when there is at most one visible page); items whose pageId names no visible page are skipped; the initial `focusIndex` computation is unchanged.
Both `setAppState({ searchMatches })` mappings add `pageId: searchMatch.pageId` to each match.

In the focus effect, right after `if (match) {`: when `match.pageId !== app.state.activePageId`, call `app.setActivePage(match.pageId)` and `return`; the scene nonce change re-runs the search, and the effect then focuses the match on its page.

`ListItem` gains an optional `pageName?: string | null` prop; when it is a non-empty string, a `
{t("search.onPage", { name: props.pageName })}
` follows the `preview-text` div.
`getVisiblePages` is imported from `@excalidraw/element` by extending the existing `isTextElement, isFrameLikeElement` import.

sites.rule: Switch to the match's page first, per the rules.
Render the page label when pageName is set.
Scan every page's non-deleted elements and build the page-name map.

uses.reason: Where match items are pushed in handleSearch, to add pageId/pageName.

rules: Add a `.preview-page` rule next to the existing `.preview-text` rule: `font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-gray-50); margin-top: 0.125rem;`.
